# Season Plan 2026-27

Getting every team through the 2026-27 season with the basics in place. Started in June 2026 when the coaches' availability forms came back.

## Outcome

Every team has a qualified coach, a team manager, a pitch slot and a fixture list for 2026-27.

## Current State

- Season started Saturday 5 September 2026. 13 football teams, the athletics junior squad and the masters group are all running.
- Coaches: 12 of 13 football teams have a coach with a current qualification. The under-12s coach starts the Northmere FA course on 7 November ([[northmere-fa-coaching-course-calendar-2026]]).
- Team managers: all 13 teams have one. The under-10s manager is new and shadowing Jakub until half-term.
- Pitch slots: agreed for all teams, with the Saturday changing-room overlap handled by staggered slots ([[saturday-pitch-timetable-2026-27]], [[changing-room-supervision-rules]]).
- Fixtures: Northmere FA league fixtures published to 20 December; the under-7s and under-8s play festivals, not fixtures ([[mini-football-festival]]).

## Scope and Boundaries

Teams, coaches, managers, pitch slots, fixtures and referees for one season. Safeguarding checks for those volunteers are tracked in [[safeguarding-training-refresh]], not here; I only note whether a coach is cleared to start. The girls' section has its own Project ([[girls-football-section]]). Track time at Oakreach belongs to [[school-partnership]].

## Working Context

The hard constraint is Saturday morning. Two full-size pitches and three mini pitches serve 11 junior teams between 09:00 and 13:00, and the adult men's team kicks off at 14:00, so its players arrive while juniors are still changing. Martin built the timetable around that overlap after Aoife's interim rules came in on 5 September.

Junior numbers fell from 168 to 161. The under-14 boys lost five players and the under-16s are down to 15, which is enough for 11-a-side but tight for away games. Jakub is talking to the under-16s about joining up with another club's team in 2027 if numbers fall further.

Referees: Martin has seven qualified referees for junior home games and a list of two parents on the Northmere FA referee course ([[referee-availability-2026-27]]).

## Next Actions

- [ ] Get the under-12s coach qualified (course 7 November, assessment in December).
- [ ] Review the Saturday timetable at the January coaches' forum, after the first half-term of staggered changing.
- [ ] Publish the January to May fixtures as soon as Northmere FA releases them.
- [ ] Decide with Jakub by March 2027 whether the under-16s can field a team next season.
